title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
blurb: In visual novel form, it's almost like the sober examination of the unrestrained materialism and absent moral center of the Roaring Twenties jumps right out at you! (Norm link)
blurb2: Leave it to Scott to take all the fun out of a reclusive yet rich and mysteriously well-connected man inviting hordes of other rich and powerful men to "party" with "young women" at his private estate on an island.
